questions.explain: Since v4 (September 2026) the `mavsdk` package is a native binding through the C wrapper, no gRPC and no second process; the old gRPC client lives on as `mavsdk-grpc`.
Subscriptions never end; in 4.x a one-off value comes from `await tel.position()`.

questions.q: PX4 exits Offboard right after starting. The cause:
options: Setpoints before start, or slower than 2 Hz
questions.explain: You need an initial setpoint and a continuous stream.

questions.q: The preferred bridge for PX4 + ROS 2:
questions.explain: MAVROS — for ArduPilot/ROS or special cases.

questions.q: Who should ensure safety when the script on the companion “dies”?
questions.explain: The companion advises, the autopilot decides.

questions.q: Waiting for `health.is_global_position_ok` without a timeout on a vehicle without GPS leads to:

questions.explain: The upper layers implement the same microservices.
